bio: Qingyuan Fu trained in architecture at Hubei University of Technology (2016 — 2021), then spent four years on schematic and competition work at the China Architecture Design & Research Group before founding DoraWolf Studio in Wuhan in 2023. The studio's working method is simple: read each site — its topography, climate, and civic edges — before committing to form, then push the design through a small kit of computational tools (Sketchup, Grasshopper, Rhino, Ladybug) until it has the precision to be built. Sustainable design and parametric modelling are not a manifesto here — they're the daily fabric of the practice.

studio.name: DoraWolf Studio
studio.ethos: A small kit of tools, used well. Restrained form. Public buildings owe the street a calm, legible presence.
